question: The efforts of Malayalam poet Vallathol Narayana Menon and dancer and guru Kalyanikutty Amma brought back and gave a new life to the dance form ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniyattam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a classical dance form from Kerala, India.
 
• The efforts of Malayalam poet **Vallathol Narayana Menon** and dancer and guru **Kalyanikutty Amma** were instrumental in reviving and giving new life to Mohiniyattam.
 
• Vallathol Narayana Menon was a prominent figure in Malayalam literature and played a key role in the revival of classical arts in Kerala.
 
• Kalyanikutty Amma was a renowned dancer and teacher of Mohiniyattam, contributing significantly to its development and popularity.
 
• Mohiniyattam is characterized by its graceful and elegant movements, often described as the dance of the enchantress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohiniyattam** is traditionally performed by women, depicting themes of love and devotion.
 
• The dance form combines elements of Bharatanatyam and Kathakali, two other classical dance forms from South India.
 
• Mohiniyattam's repertoire includes various dance sequences like Cholkettu, Varnam, and Padam, each with its own unique style and rhythm.
 
• The costume for Mohiniyattam is typically white or off-white with gold borders, reflecting the traditional attire of Kerala.
 
• The dance form has a rich history and continues to be an integral part of Kerala's cultural heritage.
